name: ui-ux
summary: Add /redesign command — from-scratch page/flow rework (rethinks layout + IA + UX, NOT a restyle) rebuilt inside the app's existing design system, with a mandatory approval gate before any code. Composes the pack's design specialists (design-system-architect for system extraction + conformance, ux-reviewer for the IA/flow proposal, ui-design-sweep closure verbs to finish, design-iterate for optional post-approval visual variants); renders the rebuilt surface (Playwright) to earn its RTL/a11y/responsive checkmarks instead of asserting them. Sibling to /enhance-ui + /polish (which preserve structure). Frontend / mobile only. v1.2.0 unchanged: ui-crawl + ui-crawl-fix. v1.1.0 unchanged: ui-design-sweep 19-verb skill.
